title: The Extraction of the Free Port
author: Lena Voss
blurb: Ansel Almeida, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
